EPIC_STATUS_AND_BRAINSTORM_RETURN 2026-05-24T05:05Z:

=== Session deliverables (KEPT — sound foundation, not affected by architectural defect) ===

1. ACLI integration hardened with 4 confirmed-fixed code bugs:
   - 4fa9-0846-519e-4c30 ProjectKey null (PR #333, merged)
   - 5010-1c6a-9387-4b5b priority dict shape (PR #334, merged)
   - c916-74a1-ed06-40e4 add_label --label flag (PR #335, merged)
   - 952f2b7457 _JIRA_SUMMARY_MAX_CHARS off-by-one (part of PR #335)
2. Sanitizers added (_sanitize_label, _sanitize_summary) to defend against untrusted user input.
3. 36 contract regression tests pinning every empirically-verified ACLI invocation pattern.
4. Independent validation audit cross-referenced our implementation against authoritative Atlassian docs + 20-plus GitHub prior-art consumers. 21/22 patterns CONFIRMED-CORRECT (1 off-by-one fixed).
5. Closure-Check cleanup complete: legacy bridge files deleted (PR #334); rollback-impossible-after-Nh forward-fix path documented inline (commit ed41294987); CLAUDE.md trimmed.
6. Epic Closure Checks rewritten with in-session analogs replacing time-based requirements.

=== Closure Checks that were VERIFIED this session (evidence captured) ===

  - CC1 legacy YAMLs deleted + no post-cutover scheduled runs: VERIFIED (LIVE_EVIDENCE_BATCH_1)
  - CC3b heartbeat firing on simulated disable: VERIFIED via story 7004 closure (canary ticket c03a-2e77 fired autonomously)
  - CC4 weekly-fsck 2 consecutive cycles: VERIFIED (runs 26350906355 + 26350930124, identical 1738 anomaly counts proves stable snapshot)
  - CC5 no legacy code refs: VERIFIED (final grep returns 0 non-shim-exempt matches)
  - CC7 rollback-impossible forward-fix path documented: VERIFIED via rollback-bridge-cutover.sh header block
  - SC7 rollback dry-run: VERIFIED via story 7339 user-override 2026-05-24

=== Defects that BLOCK closure (returning to brainstorm) ===

Pass 1 live verification surfaced P0 architectural bug 7f36-6ca9-d9ae-432b: differ + create_one inversion creates a NEW DUPLICATE Jira issue rather than mirroring unmapped Jira issues down to local jira-prefixed tickets. 5 confirmed duplicates from earlier failed passes (DIG-4006 through DIG-4010) deleted this session. bridge_state writes are not persisted across passes (written to main-branch working dir on GHA runner, never committed).

JUSTIFICATION FOR RETURNING TO BRAINSTORM (not fix-bug):

1. Each prior defect HID the next one. ProjectKey hid priority hid label hid the inversion. Live verification at the integration level is the only path to surfacing the inversion — not a tactical-bug property.

2. The inversion is in the CONTRACT between differ and applier, not in any single function. The differ emits 'create' mutations without a direction marker (inbound vs outbound). The applier dispatches on action, not direction. Fixing it requires reshaping the differ-to-applier mutation schema, which is a contract change.

3. bridge_state persistence is a separate axis. Even fixing the inversion does not fix bridge_state persistence; the two defects compound but can be addressed independently. Both touch the architecture, neither is a single-function patch.

4. The capability probe (cfd6) verified ACLI surface, NOT the band composition. The probe's scope was at the wrong layer to surface the inversion. This is what process bugs 0dee-a535 and fe3a-a3fb already document.

5. The remediation requires design decisions (which side is authoritative; how to track that authority across the differ/applier boundary; what the bootstrap path looks like; where bridge_state lives). These are brainstorm/preplanning decisions, not implementation decisions. fix-bug Phase D2 would classify these as COMPLEX and force epic escalation anyway.

6. The blast radius scales with (unmapped Jira issues x passes until interrupted). On a 9-min pass against 1825 unmapped issues with no dedup primer in place, the blast radius is 1825 duplicate Jira issues. This is a different category of risk than a unit-bounded bug.

=== Brainstorm inputs ===

When epic 3a03 re-enters brainstorm, the inputs should include:
  - 7f36-6ca9-d9ae-432b architectural inversion (P0; this session)
  - 4fa9-0846-519e-4c30 ProjectKey null (FIXED; evidence that ACLI invocation needs per-band feasibility verification)
  - 5010-1c6a-9387-4b5b priority dict shape (FIXED; evidence that snapshot field shape needs explicit type contracts)
  - c916-74a1-ed06-40e4 add_label --label flag (FIXED; evidence of dead-code-becoming-load-bearing)
  - 0dee-a535-45dd-4bc4 brainstorm/preplanning research depth (process; this session)
  - fe3a-a3fb-4523-4ccc implementation agent ignored old code (process; this session)
  - Independent validation audit findings: external authoritative + empirical evidence ranks above internal prior art

=== Operator state ===

  - Reconcile Bridge cron: state=disabled_manually (no further auto-passes will fire)
  - Jira state restored: 5 duplicate DIG issues deleted 2026-05-24T05:00Z
  - tickets-branch HEAD: 23d853bebd (with this session's comments)
  - origin/main HEAD: 56ed89083c (post PR #335 merge, all ACLI hardening shipped)

=== Session handoff ===

Full session context will be saved to docs/findings/3a03-recovery-session-2026-05-24.md and committed before session close. Pick-up: open epic with these inputs for the brainstorm restart.
